posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Fittipaldo on his panic level with the 2026 Steelers: “I'll ratchet that up a little bit because there are a couple of teams in the AFC that are better than I thought they would be, namely the Raiders and the Browns. I don't know how long that's going to last. We could be sitting here a month from now and those teams could be back down to earth, but you have to take advantage of this stretch coming up. By early November, you better be above .500 because we know what's waiting in late November, December, and January. That's the toughest part of your schedule, and if you're not in contention by the trade deadline, you're probably going to fall out of it. To me, you have to take advantage of these games. Go win the games you're supposed to win. My concern level is probably a three or a four right now, but it'll be much higher if they somehow screw this up over the next month.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.text: JJ Watt on the amount of trouble he would get in with his Brothers during their Childhood: “A lot. A lot of trouble. We played mini sticks growing up. We're a hockey family, so we were always playing in the basement. There was a lot of drywall repair going on. There were a lot of bloody noses, Band-Aids, and paper towels used to clean ourselves up. Out in the front yard, we loved playing games like trying to down a punt at the 1-yard line, seeing if you could stop it before it reached the end of the driveway. We also played toe-tap games, trying to make catches and get both feet in bounds. Our childhood was a blast, and I think it's a huge reason we all ended up where we are today. It came from that competitive nature we had growing up.” #Steelers #NFL

posts.author: Blitz_Burgh@sportsbots.xyz
posts.text: Kaboly isn’t panicking about the 2026 Steelers: “Right now, my panic meter is probably at a one, and the only reason it's even at a one is because they're a little banged up in the secondary. There's a lot of football left. We don't know how Mike McCarthy is going to approach this, and we don't know how the team is going to respond. It might end up being a positive. They could rip off four or five wins in a row, and suddenly we're having a completely different conversation. So I'm not worried at all right now. I'm like Mike McCarthy and Patrick Graham: take it one game at a time. I'm not riding that roller coaster. I'm too old for that. I don't even go on roller coasters anymore. Let's see how this thing plays out before we start panicking.” #Steelers #NFL

Chargers OT Rashawn Slater underwent successful ankle surgery yesterday in LA, a tightrope procedure aimed at accelerating his return from a high ankle sprain.

Slater, who was injured in Sunday’s game vs the Seahawks, will be placed on Injured Reserve and begin rehabbing.

Good news: Steelers S DeShon Elliott has returned to practice, though he remains on IR.

Bad news: Steelers WR Michael Pittman Jr aggravated his foot injury, and coach Mike McCarthy said he'll miss multiple weeks. Pittman had been dealing with plantar fasciitis.

posts.author: rapsheet.bsky.social
posts.text:
The Cowboys are activating All-Pro G Tyler Smith from Injured Reserve to play tonight against the Bucs. A big lift.

One of the NFL's best, Smith had thumb surgery right before the season, hoping to return as soon as possible. After a full practice on Wednesday, he's back.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Panthers Pro Bowl CB Jaycee Horn is out indefinitely after suffering a quad injury in Sunday’s loss to the Browns, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

Horn is seeking a second opinion. But he’s likely to land on injured reserve and miss significant time.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Bucs QB Baker Mayfield underwent tests that showed no fracture and no tendon or ligament damage in his right thumb, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports. 

Mayfield will need to regain strength after Sunday’s dislocation and likely will miss some time. But good news overall.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
By trading J.J. McCarthy now, the Vikings save over $4.6M in cash and cap space and get an unconditional fifth-round pick in the next draft that, depending how the Giants finish, could end up being a top-150 selection.

Meanwhile, New York adds another former first-round pick QB.

posts.author: tompelissero.bsky.social
posts.text:
Trade! The Vikings are sending QB J.J. McCarthy to the Giants for a 2027 fifth-round pick, sources tell The Ringer and Netflix Sports.

With Jaxson Dart out for the regular season, New York adds another young QB, while Minnesota gains flexibility and McCarthy gets a fresh start.

More tests to come Monday, but Daniels will be out for some time: “We’ll rally around Marcus (Mariota).”

posts.text:
Former #Bucs OC Byron Leftwich is back in coaching as he is joining Deion Sanders’ staff at Colorado.

Leftwich interviewed for multiple NFL jobs this past cycle (Pats HC, Seahawks OC) but now makes the move to college.
